short_bio: District Attorney of Fulton County, Georgia, who brought the state election-interference case against Donald Trump.
biography:
Fani Willis was born in Inglewood, California, and studied at Howard University and Emory University School of Law. She worked as a prosecutor in Fulton County, Georgia, before entering private practice.

She was elected Fulton County District Attorney in 2020 and took office in 2021. In August 2023 a grand jury she convened indicted Donald Trump and eighteen others under Georgia’s racketeering law over efforts to overturn the 2020 result in the state.

In December 2024 the Georgia Court of Appeals disqualified her from the case over her relationship with a lawyer she had hired.
